findings.text: Previous blocking 1 (MCP-side refusals not audited): RESOLVED. foreman-mcp/directspec.mjs checkControl now only checks the action name; checkProposal still refuses unprintable, overlong, secret-shaped and attribution text. A malformed target or value reaches supervisor/inbox.mjs validateControl, which refuses it and auditRefusedControl writes the record (audit text goes through directstore clip/redactLong on read). New tests refusedAndAudited cover 'abc', a 28-char id, start_job 'zzzz', set_rank '10000' and 'first', set_depends_on '12', assign 'Codex', park with a proposal id, and the MCP tool path foreman_set_priority 'urgent'.

Previous blocking 2 (backoff start not undoable): RESOLVED. supervisor/directjobs.mjs startWaiting now returns undo {op:'pause_job'}; reverseDirect routes it to directPause, and the real pause (stopjob.mjs overseerPause) accepts a queued job. Test 'undo: a start of a job waiting out its backoff is reversed by a pause'.

Previous blocking 3 (undo of a stop skipped resume checks): RESOLVED. restartStopped now calls checkResumable(deps.team, ..., deps.roleOf, ['stopped']), which applies the PR closed/newer head check, allowance, circuit breaker and providerRoleFull. jobresume.mjs gained an optional 'allowed' parameter defaulting to RESUMABLE, so the homeowner's resume_job and direct start_job are unchanged. Test 'undo of a stop goes through the checks of a resume' covers no free slot and PR closed, with no resume call.

Previous blocking 4 (false dashrender claim): RESOLVED as to substance. The description now says dashrender.mjs has a 2-line edit (one import, one card), which matches the diff. A residual immaterial slip: it says the line count is 'unchanged at 1044'; the file goes from 1037 at the merge base to 1038 (1044 is the size-baseline.json value, and check-size reports it as smaller than the baseline, so the ratchet gate holds). Fix the wording. Separately, one added line in a file over the 500-line threshold is a small ratchet growth against the merge base; the check-size gate accepts it against its baseline, so this is a follow-up only.
